items.title: Oak trees + stone cluster shipped
items.notes: Baseline world dressing already in runtime.
items.description: Oak variants and stones are baked. Do not remake first — refine only when a higher-tier kit needs a shared base.

items.title: Player body v2 (skinned + Idle) shipped
items.notes: Shared humanoid base for kits + creation + NPC test stand-in. Runtime player.gltf has 37 joints (finger/thumb bones under each hand). Prefab: assets/prefabs/NPC/npc_test.prefab.json.
items.description: Player_V2 rigged body is the foundation for modular hair/outfit/weapon swaps. Prerequisite for archetype kits and character creation preview.

items.title: Dead log + stump shipped
items.description: Both authored and baked. Remaining Tier 1 props still need Blockbench meshes.

items.title: Character-creation hair styles (modular)
items.notes: Prerequisite for creation flow looking real.
items.description: At least 3–5 readable hair meshes/slots that attach to the shared player body. Without these, character creation is numbers-only and feels unfinished.

items.title: Face / skin tint variants for creation
items.description: Small set of skin tones / face paint or mesh variants aligned to theme palette. Needed so creation choices are visible on the body before Act 0 spawn.

items.title: Ashfell Blade starter outfit kit
items.notes: Former Squire kit id. Tunic, wraps, belt, boots.
items.description: Modular Ashfell Blade kit matching character-direction (legacy Squire turnaround). Prerequisite for archetype creation preview and Act 0 player silhouette.

items.title: Outrider starter outfit kit
items.notes: Former Archer kit id. Cloak/hood, bracer, quiver attach — concept still open.
items.description: Needs turnaround concept lock then Blockbench kit. Blocks Outrider creation fantasy and bow attach readability.

items.title: Runecaster starter outfit kit
items.notes: Former Acolyte kit id. Rune/sigil caster look — concept still open (not crystal-warden robes by default).
items.description: Needs turnaround concept lock then Blockbench kit. Blocks Runecaster creation fantasy.

items.title: Outrider + Runecaster kit concept turnarounds
items.notes: Legacy item id. Prerequisite art-direction lock before modeling.
items.description: Open in character-direction: approve front/side sheets for Outrider and Runecaster so kits do not fork canon silhouettes mid-production.

items.title: Starter weapons (sword, bow, rune focus)
items.notes: Attachables for combat + creation. Staff/rod may become rune-inscribed focus.
items.description: Short sword, bow+arrow, and Runecaster focus (staff/rod or inscribed token) as attachable meshes on shared body slots. Prerequisite for weapon feel and creation preview.

items.title: Tier 1 props (bush, campfire, crate, barrel, torch)
items.notes: Barrel, lantern, wall_torch baked + sandbox-placed; bush_wide still primitive.
items.description: Tier 1 Blockbench props shipped (bush/tall, campfire, crate, barrel, lantern, wall torch). Wide bush still primitive. Torch/lantern particle flame remains under effects_campfire_flame.

items.title: Wheelbarrow + supply cart (A0-03/04)
items.description: Overturned wheelbarrow is story-critical for Arkand meet. Cart/wagon fills approach. Prerequisite for staging A0-03 without cubes.

items.title: Drawbridge + battlement kit
items.description: Modular walls, corners, crenels, drawbridge planks/chains/posts. Prerequisite for fortress placement and cinematic framing of the hold.

items.title: Barricades, catapult, keep gate
items.description: Road barricades, simple catapult silhouette, keep door/gate. Prerequisite for siege combat readability and backdrop events.

items.title: Arkand + Grenge + Tessera/Imperium soldiers
items.description: Arkand plate, Grenge green-shroud accent, generic Tessera guard, Imperium footsoldier. Prerequisite for combat waves looking like the story cast.

items.title: Tier 4 player camp kit
items.description: Anywhere-camp visuals for A0-09. Prerequisite for camp wake cinematic and travel tutorial feeling like a place.

items.title: Fortress prefabs placed on Calrenoth sculpt
items.description: Place wall/gate/drawbridge kits so beats A0-03–A0-06 have a readable fortress. Depends on sculpt + kit art.

items.title: Starting archetypes authored in World Forge
items.notes: DEC-0044: ashfell_blade / outrider / runecaster + lane org tags.
items.description: Ensure archetypes.worldforge.json has ids, display names, summaries, home-org tags, and story refs creation/runtime can consume. Prerequisite for creation UI binding.

items.title: Lane home org story spines drafted
items.notes: House Ashfell / Outrider Lodge / Runecaster Guild — DEC-0044.
items.description: Story essays + World Forge seeds describe each starter’s home org, sub-themes, and hybrid bind into major factions. Prerequisite for per-lane quests and creation copy.

items.title: First home-org quest seeds per lane
items.notes: After Act 0 shared siege; Dom+owner name faces.
items.description: Author at least one early quest (or system-quest stub) per home org so Ashfell Blade / Outrider / Runecaster each have a distinct mid-game pull before faction bind.

items.title: Systems + comps design pass for three lanes
items.notes: Combat systems and party/build comps — still open after DEC-0044 naming lock.
items.description: Define what systems and comps mean for Ashfell Blade / Outrider / Runecaster (including sub-themes), then how each is playable before specialization.

items.title: Modular kit slot schema (hair/outfit/weapon)
items.notes: Data contract before art swaps attach.
items.description: Document and implement attachment slots on the character asset so hair, outfits, and weapons swap without per-archetype body remakes. Prerequisite for creation preview and loadouts.

items.title: Starter kits bound to archetype ids
items.description: Each starting archetype points at its outfit kit + default weapon. Prerequisite for creation flow and Act 0 spawn loadout.

items.title: Creation preview uses kit swaps
items.description: Selecting an archetype (and hair/outfit options) updates the preview mesh immediately. Prerequisite for a shippable character creation beat.

items.title: Locomotion + melee vertical-slice base
items.description: Player move/attack and basic hit reaction path must be reliable before Act 0 waves. Treat remaining gaps as P0 blockers for combat workstream.

items.title: Character asset attach slots runtime
items.description: Load and apply modular kit parts on the skinned body. Prerequisite for archetype kits and creation preview.

items.title: Character creation flow UI + persist
items.notes: Beat A0-02 — blocked on kits looking real.
items.description: Playable create: pick archetype, hair/skin/outfit options, difficulty; persist into spawn. Without art kits + slots, keep status honest (wip/blocked).

items.title: Quest stage / flag runtime for Act 0
items.notes: TICKET-0225 FlagRuntime + resolve_fork; QuestRuntime already shipped.
items.description: Advance objectives, set flags, gate soft corridors. World Forge JSON alone is not enough.

items.title: Dialogue runtime from quest / volumes
items.notes: Lua/MCP dialogue_start + talk_act0 volume; polished choice UI is ui_dialogue_presentation.
items.description: Fire World Forge dialogue trees from quest stages and interaction volumes. Prerequisite for storyline beats feeling playable.

items.title: Soft-gate / region pressure plumbing
items.description: Engine support to soft-block Act 0 escape until flags clear. Prerequisite for gameplay corridor design.

items.title: Scripted spawn / wave system
items.description: Deterministic spawn points + wave clear conditions for road blockers and drawbridge hold. Prefer data-driven over one-off hardcode.

items.title: Particle system MVP API
items.notes: TICKET-0122 needs-approval — Roblox-shaped CPU emitters + campfire wire-up.
items.description: Spawn/update/draw path content can drive for siege fire/ash/fog. Prerequisite for effects_siege_particles.

items.title: Event / timeline sequencer MVP
items.description: Minimal sequenced actions: camera, wait, dialogue, VFX, lock/unlock control. Prerequisite for prologue, Luceran, Creotar theatrical beats.

items.title: Camera path / lock helpers
items.notes: Prerequisite for staged scenes. TICKET-0222 shipped.
items.description: Blend to authored look-ats and hold player input during theatrical beats. Used by cinematics and Grenge briefing.

items.title: Anywhere-camp instance / travel hooks
items.description: Travel to camp, rest HP, companion staging, travel to map destinations. Prerequisite for A0-09 handoff gameplay.

items.title: Thin inventory grant + equip (Act 0)
items.notes: Prerequisite for playable Landfall loot. EPIC-0018 / TICKET-0237.
items.description: Session inventory that can grant, hold, and equip a small set of items (starter weapon + finds). Soft lane multipliers optional in this row if cheap; hard class locks forbidden (DEC-0048). Full catalog/craft deferred.

items.title: Calrenoth siege sculpt / layout baseline
items.description: Western peninsula tip layout with approach + moat-scale drawbridge space. Prerequisite for art placement and combat pathing.

items.title: Post-process hook for AO / tone
items.description: Expose a restrained AO/tone pass for siege mood. Prerequisite for effects_post_process polish.

items.title: Siege particles (fire, ash, fog)
items.description: Minimal set for catapult fire, ash fall, Luceran fog. Depends on coding particle MVP.

items.title: Post-process (AO / siege tone)
items.description: Tune AO/tone for stone/keep/fire readability. Depends on post-process hook.

items.title: Campfire + torch flame particles
items.notes: Campfire wired to campfire_flame.particle.json; wall_torch/lantern meshes + lights shipped — torch emitter still pending.
items.description: Campfire already uses particle fire. Add particle flame to wall_torch (and optional lantern ember) once desired; keep warm point lights.

items.title: Signal pyre / watchtower fire VFX
items.description: Hill signal fire for optional side content after core siege VFX.

items.title: Siege / vision audio beds
items.description: Minimal loops/stings for approach under fire, Luceran dread, Creotar vision. Prerequisite for theatrical beats feeling finished.

items.title: Imperium footsoldier combat prefab
items.description: Placeable enemy using Imperium soldier mesh + simple melee brain/script. Prerequisite for road-blocker waves.

items.title: Road-blocker combat waves (A0-04)
items.notes: Must feel fightable before fortress entry.
items.description: Two clearable encounters on the Calrenoth approach. Depends on enemy prefab, weapons, and sculpt path.

items.title: Drawbridge hold waves (A0-06)
items.description: Timed hold with clear succeed/fail. Depends on drawbridge art/placement and wave system.

items.title: Starter weapon hit-feel (sword / bow / staff)
items.description: Simple but distinct timing/range so creation choice matters. Depends on weapon meshes + melee base.

items.title: Calrenoth soft-gate tutorial corridor
items.notes: Seamless tutorial, not a chapter load.
items.description: Author gates/flags so player cannot skip to Ledgeport before camp handoff.

items.title: mq_act0_calrenoth playable end-to-end
items.description: Wire stages from Arkand rescue through camp. Depends on quest/dialogue runtime and story beats.

items.title: Act 0 interaction volumes (rescue, talk, signal)
items.notes: Prerequisite for Arkand / Grenge / Larrell beats.
items.description: Place and hook volumes that start dialogue or objectives at the right locations.

items.title: Anywhere-camp travel / rest (A0-09)
items.description: After vision, wake at camp; rest; travel to destinations including Ledgeport.

items.title: Act 0 Landfall lootables (small slice)
items.notes: Not a full item pool — ~4–8 defs. DEC-0048 / TICKET-0237.
items.description: Players obtain some items during Landfall: starter kit weapon, 1–2 approach finds, low-rate footsoldier commons, one story-grant reward, optional single obscure nook rare. Place pickups/grants on the siege → camp path. Does not block boot→camp goal until inventory thin path exists.

items.title: Calrenoth ruined revisit state
items.description: Post-fall ruined location on the seamless map. Depends on fortress art + quest completion flags.

items.title: Act 0 beat sheet reviewed (A0-01…A0-09)
items.description: Owner/Dom review of Landfall beats so art/cinematics do not chase moving targets. Mark done when beat statuses are accepted for MVP.

items.title: Beats A0-01…A0-03 playable copy
items.description: Lock and stage prologue, creation handoff, Arkand intro branches.

items.title: Beats A0-04…A0-07 playable copy
items.description: Objective copy + flags for approach, Grenge, drawbridge, Larrell choice.

items.title: Beats A0-08…A0-09 playable copy
items.description: Creotar vision dialogue filled enough to play; camp handoff lines locked.

items.title: Key dialogue trees playable
items.description: Keep Twine import current; each speaker completable and quest-hooked.

items.title: Grenge / Larrell / Damius continuity flags
items.description: Author flags so supporting cast can reappear in Act 1; optional hostage choice tracked.

items.title: Event timeline usable for Act 0 beats
items.notes: Tooling prerequisite for all theatrical scenes. TICKET-0222 gate shipped.
items.description: Confirm coding_event_timeline can drive camera + dialogue + VFX + control lock for Landfall. Content work waits on this.

items.title: Prologue throne cinematic (A0-01)
items.description: Throne zoom, Frangitur address, Shroud beat, handoff to creation.

items.title: Siege backdrop event (approach under fire)
items.description: Timed catapult/impact/ash events while player fights. Depends on clutter art + particles + timeline.

items.title: Grenge courtyard briefing staging (A0-05)
items.description: Frame Grenge/Damius then return control to dialogue.

items.title: Luceran shadow / black fog event (A0-07)
items.description: Fog, dread, pale rider silhouette, collapse. Depends on fog VFX + timeline + story beat.

items.title: Realm of Darkness / Creotar vision (A0-08)
items.description: Full theatrical vision with lighting + dialogue. Depends on filled story stubs and timeline.

items.title: Camp wake handoff beat (A0-09)
items.description: Short wake staging onto camp kit then return control.

items.title: Play HUD chrome (HP / objective / prompts)
items.notes: Screen HUD: HP + class stamina/magic + objective. World billboards for prompts; Lua world_ui_*.
items.description: Ship a coherent play HUD: health (and stamina if used), current quest objective text, and contextual interaction prompts. Layout should stay legible at 1080p+ and not fight cinematic letterboxing. Uses canvas/HUD toolkit — polish presentation here even when bind plumbing lives under coding.

items.title: Player dialogue presentation canvas
items.notes: Pencil dialogue-ui.pen guideline: chips, prompt strip, portrait, keys 1–4 shipped in canvas/runtime.
items.description: In-play dialogue UI: speaker name, body text, choice list, advance/back affordances, focus capture while open. Distinct from World Forge dialogue graph editing. Required for Grenge/Larrell/Arkand/Creotar beats to feel playable.

items.title: Character creation screen UX
items.description: Creation flow presentation: archetype cards, hair/skin/outfit pickers, difficulty, confirm. Preview must read on the Player_V2 body. Coding owns persist/slots; this row tracks layout, copy, and feel.

items.title: World interaction prompt UX
items.notes: Talk / rest / investigate Press-E billboards on sample volumes.
items.description: Consistent on-screen prompts when volumes or interactables are available (talk, pick up, signal pyre, rest/travel). Avoid buried keybinds-only discovery for Act 0 tutorial beats.

items.title: Boot → prologue → creation handoff UX
items.description: First-run flow from engine boot through prologue watch into character creation without dead ends or editor chrome leaking into play. Skip/continue affordances must be obvious.

items.title: Pause / system menu (resume, settings stub)
items.description: Pause canvas with Resume and a minimal settings stub (sensitivity/volume placeholders ok). Must pop cleanly and restore play HUD. Proves DEC-0025 stack for Act 0 demos.

items.title: Quest journal / objective list screen
items.description: Openable journal showing Act 0 main quest stages and current objective. HUD line remains; journal is for reorienting after long fights or cutscenes.

items.title: Combat hit / damage feedback UI
items.description: Player-readable hit feedback: HP bar reaction, optional floating numbers or screen edge flash. Enough for road-blocker and drawbridge fights to feel fair without final VFX polish.

items.title: Soft-gate / region pressure UI cues
items.description: When Calrenoth soft-gates block skipping ahead, surface a short on-screen reason (direction, blocked path, talk-to-NPC) instead of silent collision. Ties to standing/pressure plumbing.

items.title: Camp UI (rest / travel / companion talk)
items.description: Camp instance screens: rest HP, travel to map destinations, talk-to-companion entry points. Keep layout simple; story copy can stay stubbed if dialogue trees exist.

items.title: Cinematic letterbox + skip affordance
items.description: During prologue/siege/vision events: letterbox or HUD hide, clear Skip/Continue control, restore play chrome afterward. Presentation only — timeline content stays under Cinematics.

items.title: Accessibility baseline (type, contrast, remap hooks)
items.description: Minimum Act 0 bar: readable type size, contrast on HUD/dialogue, and documented input remap hooks (even if full remapping UI is thin). Do not block demo on full a11y IA.

items.title: Act Zero Overview readiness tracker
items.notes: This pane — keep statuses and deps honest.
items.description: Curated checklist with priorities, workstreams, descriptions, images, and dependsOn. Owners update after real progress — not World Forge field %.

items.title: Playable demo exit met (boot → camp)
items.description: Mark done when cold boot → creation → fight approach → Grenge → drawbridge → vision → camp plays in one sitting. Anything else is P2+. Overview ranks open work by progress toward this goal.

items.title: Art pipeline review (Blockbench → glTF → prefab)
items.description: Confirm bake scripts, slot naming, and prefab swap steps so hair/outfits/weapons land consistently. Prerequisite for parallel art work.

items.title: Triage P0 deps weekly (art vs coding vs story)
items.description: Use Overview dependsOn: if character creation is blocked on hair/kits, mark creation blocked and schedule art first. Repeat for combat/cinematics.

items.title: Twine ↔ World Forge sync habit
items.description: Re-import Act 0 Twine and spot-check entry nodes before calling story beats done.
